name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
summary: Income support of ₹6,000 per year to eligible land-holding farmer families across the country.
howToApply: Visit pmkisan.gov.in or your nearest CSC (Common Service Centre)
Submit Aadhaar, land records, and bank account details
Get verified by the state nodal officer
Amount is credited every 4 months

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
summary: Comprehensive crop insurance covering pre-sowing to post-harvest losses due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases.
howToApply: Approach your bank, PACS, or CSC before the cut-off date each season
Provide land records, sowing certificate, Aadhaar, bank details
Premium is auto-deducted; insured sum tied to crop MSP

name: Kisan Credit Card
benefit: Loans up to ₹3 lakh at 4% interest (with subsidy)
summary: Short-term credit for cultivation expenses, post-harvest expenses, and household consumption.
howToApply: Visit any commercial bank, cooperative bank, or RRB
Submit Aadhaar, PAN, land records, and 2 passport photos
Card issued in 15 days; usable as RuPay debit card

name: PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana
benefit: Up to 55% subsidy on drip/sprinkler irrigation
summary: Enhances water use efficiency through micro-irrigation. Higher subsidy for small & marginal farmers.
howToApply: Apply through your state horticulture / agriculture department
Get soil and water source verified
Choose an empanelled vendor for installation

name: PM Kusum (Solar Pumps)
summary: Solar-powered agricultural pumps and grid-connected solar power plants for farmers.
howToApply: Register on state discom portal
Submit land papers and existing electricity connection details
Pay farmer share (usually 10%) after approval

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
summary: Farmers get a personalized soil health card every 2 years telling them exactly what nutrients their soil needs.
howToApply: Contact your block agriculture officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra
Soil samples are collected from your field
Card is issued within 30 days

name: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
summary: Pan-India electronic trading platform networking existing APMC mandis for better price discovery.
howToApply: Register at enam.gov.in with Aadhaar and bank details
Get produce assayed at nearest e-NAM mandi
Accept the best online bid; payment in 24 hours
